== Description ==

Players at dinner after the Ryloth Regionals of the [[2024 Regional Championships]] in Halle, Belgium, on 26 October 2024. Faces in the photograph are not yet identified.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #worlds-24-belgium-trip, Cedrik Vanderhaegen (cedrik), 27 October 2024 (08:33 CET). Original file name: 20241026_201341.jpg (4624×3468); Slack file id F07TGD10L6S.
* '''Shared by:''' [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (Slack: cedrik)
* '''Date:''' posted 27 October 2024. Camera date from the original file name: 26 October 2024, 20:13.
* '''Identification:''' Cedrik's post names the event finishers ([[Angelo Consoli]] first, [[Quirin Fürgut]] second, Cedrik third) and says the group had dinner afterwards; the faces in this photograph are not yet matched to those names.
Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
